info.name: ShopKart - Labs 01 to 06
info.description:
Run requests in order. Tests authentication, product catalog, wishlist and shopping cart, including listed bonuses and validation errors. Creates a unique test customer and product; login cookies are handled automatically.
Lab 06 adds checkout/payment requests. Successful payment verification uses the real Razorpay Test Checkout response in the React app; no secret is stored in this collection.

exec: pm.test('JWT is in an HttpOnly cookie', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Set-Cookie')).to.match(/jwt=.+;.*HttpOnly/i); });
pm.test('Profile belongs to current customer', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()._id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('customerId')); });

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Mechanical Keyboard {{productTag}}",
  "description": "RGB mechanical keyboard with blue switches.",
  "price": 2999,
  "category": "Electronics",
  "image": "https://example.com/keyboard.jpg",
  "stock": 10
}

exec: pm.test('Product saved with creation date', function () { const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p._id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(p.createdAt).to.be.a('string'); });

pm.test('List contains created product', function () { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.count).to.eql(data.products.length); pm.expect(data.products.some(p => p._id === pm.collectionVariables.get('productId'))).to.be.true; });

pm.test('Correct product details', function () { const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p._id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('productId')); pm.expect(p.description).to.eql('RGB mechanical keyboard with blue switches.'); });

pm.test('Search finds only the test product', function () { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.count).to.eql(1); pm.expect(d.products[0]._id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('productId')); });

pm.test('Only Electronics products returned', function () { const p = pm.response.json().products; pm.expect(p.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(p.every(x => x.category === 'Electronics')).to.be.true; });
pm.test('Nonmatching category returns empty list', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().products).to.eql([]); });
pm.test('Products sorted by price', function () { const prices = pm.response.json().products.map(p => p.price); pm.expect(prices.every((p,i) => i === 0 || prices[i-1] <= p)).to.be.true; });
pm.test('Products sorted by price', function () { const prices = pm.response.json().products.map(p => p.price); pm.expect(prices.every((p,i) => i === 0 || prices[i-1] >= p)).to.be.true; });

exec: pm.test('Count and product', () => { const d=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.count).to.eql(1); pm.expect(d.wishlist[0]._id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("productId")); pm.expect(d.wishlist[0]).to.have.keys("_id","name","price","category","image","stock"); });
pm.test('One row and quantity', () => { const c=pm.response.json().cart; pm.expect(c).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(c[0].quantity).to.eql(1); });
pm.test('One row and quantity', () => { const c=pm.response.json().cart; pm.expect(c).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(c[0].quantity).to.eql(2); });

pm.test('Product details', () => { const p=pm.response.json().cart[0].product; pm.expect(p._id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("productId")); pm.expect(p.price).to.eql(2999); pm.expect(p.stock).to.eql(10); });
